rotationSign: CSS rotate(); positive = clockwise on screen

peck.howTo: Rotate #body +30 (tips the hen forward on her hips) and #head +66 (inside #body, so it adds to the body tilt). The beak tip then touches the ground line (about x 285). Return both to 0 to stand up. Head alone (+60) gives a nod that does not reach the ground.

parts.description: Far leg and toes (darker); pivot at the hip under the feathers (+ back, - forward).
Near leg and toes; pivot at the hip under the feathers (+ back, - forward).
Torso with wing; pivot at the hips over the legs. Contains 'tail' and 'head', so rotating it tips the whole hen (+ forward to peck, - leans back).
Tail feathers; nested in 'body', pivot at the root (+ tips forward/upright, - tips back/down).
Neck and head with comb, beak and wattle; nested in 'body' and drawn behind the breast so the neck base never shows; pivot at the base of the neck (+ dips forward/down to peck, - lifts).
